meta.filePurpose: Local offline demo data for the StitchCheck UI traveller flow. Uses a coherent CGK-DPS-CGK route (2026-08-29: aligned with the Atlas Sandbox supported test route used for the supervised rehearsal).
meta.piiReview: All data is local demo content: invented flight numbers (SC-101/SC-202), sample carrier labels, and placeholder times for the CGK-DPS-CGK route. No real passenger, booking reference, payment data, airline record, PII, or credential appears anywhere in this file.
